- [`src/winnr-placement-phenotype-canary.mjs`](../../src/winnr-placement-phenotype-canary.mjs) — Founder-authorized seed placement and personal-inbox canaries for Winnr mailboxes; reserves before effects and requires external reconciliation on uncertain sends. · **Use:** Measure inbox placement of Winnr senders without prospect authority _(imported by 1)_
- [`src/winnr-placement-quarantine.mjs`](../../src/winnr-placement-quarantine.mjs) — Applies quarantine to Winnr mailboxes based on placement results in the store. · **Use:** Pause senders whose placement evidence is bad _(tested; imported by 1)_
- [`src/winnr-reply-canary-verifier.mjs`](../../src/winnr-reply-canary-verifier.mjs) — Verifies Winnr reply canaries over IMAP and classifies probe network exceptions. · **Use:** Confirm canary replies arrive in Winnr mailboxes _(tested; imported by 1)_
- [`src/winnr-runtime-bootstrap.mjs`](../../src/winnr-runtime-bootstrap.mjs) — Runtime bootstrap combining Winnr adapter, post-purchase steps, credential import, fleet registration and IMAP checks. · **Use:** Bring purchased Winnr mailboxes into the sending fleet _(imported by 2)_
- [`src/winnr-sealed-bootstrap.mjs`](../../src/winnr-sealed-bootstrap.mjs) — Controller running the Winnr runtime bootstrap from sealed (encrypted) inputs. · **Use:** Bootstrap Winnr credentials without exposing secrets _(imported by 1)_
- [`src/winnr-smtp-readiness.mjs`](../../src/winnr-smtp-readiness.mjs) — SMTP readiness probe and separate IMAP readiness probe (CAPABILITY/LOGIN/LOGOUT only) for Winnr mailboxes; pauses on failure using fresh state reads. · **Use:** Gate Winnr senders as ready before sending _(tested; imported by 1)_
